interest: Shows American skepticism toward Nationalist China's state operation of former Japanese factories, via Solomon Trone's 1946 report.
overview: November 1946 State Department memoranda on Solomon R. Trone's report to T. V. Soong on former Japanese plants run as Chinese state enterprises, criticizing their overstaffing and losses.

people.name: Solomon R. Trone
people.role: Industrial Advisor to the Chinese Government

people.name: Charles R. Bennett
people.role: Officer, Office of Far Eastern Affairs

people.name: James K. Penfield
people.role: Deputy Director, Office of Far Eastern Affairs

people.name: John Carter Vincent
people.role: Director, Office of Far Eastern Affairs

subfiles.about: Internal State Department memorandum evaluating Solomon Trone's report on former enemy industrial plants taken over and operated by the Chinese Government.
subfiles.summary: AEP evaluates Trone's report on seized enemy plants, noting over 100 of more than 400 were sold while China kept others as state enterprises, and suggests referral to DRF.
subfiles.title: Memorandum from AEP to JCV on Trone's Report on Taken-over Enemy Industrial Plants

subfiles.about: Brief memorandum transmitting comments on the Bayne letter and criticizing Solomon Trone's advocacy of a planned economy in China.
subfiles.summary: Charles R. Bennett criticizes Trone's acceptance of a planned economy, arguing China would boom within two years if the government left business to private enterprise.
subfiles.title: Memorandum from CRB to ARR on the Bayne Letter and Planned Economy in China

subfiles.about: Detailed memorandum analyzing Solomon Trone's report to T. V. Soong on Shanghai industrial conditions, enemy plants, and Chinese state enterprise management.
subfiles.summary: Charles R. Bennett analyzes Trone's letter to T. V. Soong, citing mismanagement of former enemy plants and arguing state monopolies need Western managerial direction.
subfiles.title: Memorandum from Mr. Bennett to Mr. Penfield and Mr. Ringwalt on Industrial Conditions in Shanghai
